issues.jp_before: 駅前[えきまえ]{の|no-possessive}カフェ{で|de-place}友達[ともだち]{と|to-with}会[あ]いました。
issues.problem: Non-focus slot: 友達に会いました is equally natural for 'met a friend' but was not listed as an alternative.

issues.jp_before: 来週[らいしゅう]{の|no-possessive}花火[はなび]大会[たいかい]{は|wa-topic}川[かわ]{の|no-possessive}近[ちか]く{で|de-place}あります。
issues.problem: With は as topic, 川の近くであります can be misread as the formal copula, and the distractor に (…近くにあります 'is located near') becomes arguably defensible; the event reading is not forced.
issues.action: Replaced あります with 行[おこな]われます so the venue unambiguously takes で and に is plainly wrong.
